overlays.reason: Approved cumulative coordinator overlay. MOD-1 extracts framing, pending, registry, handshake, relay, scheduler, peer/Kad and metrics ownership; MOD-3 consumes safe stream snapshots and recovery policy; MOD-5.2A/LT1..LT9 transfers release, quota, lease, publisher, stream, origin, bulk, search, guard and RTT state, and LT10 closes the coordinator by removing obsolete physical separators while preserving executable code and behavior.

Approved cumulative interface overlay. Earlier slices compose the extracted domain owners; MOD-5.2A/LT1..LT9 remove delegated mutable state, and LT10 moves the wire opcode DTO to LiveTunnelFraming, removes the unused TunnelEndpoint DTO and compacts private historical commentary while retaining the public interface and compatibility aliases.

Headless production characterization hook; MOD-2.1 delegates query, cookie and bounded request parsing to WebRequestParser; MOD-2.2 delegates sessions, one-time challenges, fail-closed permissions, Host/Origin/CSRF authorization, login failures and action rate limits to WebAuthPolicy; MOD-2.3 consumes the exact WebRouteId selected by WebRouteTable; MOD-2.4 delegates JSON/HTML/XML escaping and representative response schemas to WebApiSerializer and removes partial manual JSON escapes; MOD-2.5 delegates transfer actions/comparisons, search requests/result projection, and shared catalog actions/comparisons/projection to three typed controllers; MOD-2.6 delegates MIME, cache, byte ranges and bounded file-response streaming to WebStaticAssets and WebSocketResponse; MOD-2.7 delegates sanitized status, mesh and live-debug projection to WebDiagnostics while retaining snapshot acquisition and HTTP framing; MOD-3.1 replaces check-then-pointer stream-key reads with coherent locked snapshots.

Declaration of the headless production characterization hook, composition ownership of WebAuthPolicy with request Host, Origin, Fetch Metadata and CSRF metadata, the resolved WebRouteId passed across the socket/coordinator boundary, removal of the obsolete coordinator-owned boolean parser after MOD-2.5 transfer ownership, and propagation of the typed Range request metadata required by MOD-2.6.

MOD-3.1 delegates broadcaster and viewer lifecycle state, generation, retry timers, tunnel-session scalars and broadcaster secret lifetime to the two portable session modules; MOD-3.2 delegates ordered source/downstream membership, one canonical source cap, stable selection, atomic client replacement and IPv4 diversity while retaining locks, pointer lifetime, protocol projection and external I/O in the coordinator; MOD-3.3 delegates bounded chunk ingestion, serial ordering, expiration, availability and immutable lifetime to LiveChunkWindow; MOD-3.4 delegates session-scoped public-key pinning, post-storage verified replay windows, bounded durable trust records, pruning and trust transitions to LiveStreamSecurity; MOD-3.5 delegates stable child selection, bounded whole-batch reservations, backpressure admission and replacement-safe transport leases to LiveStreamFanout through a move-only transport adapter while retaining trust, metrics and orchestration; MOD-3.6 delegates bounded in-flight retry ownership, source replenishment and emergency lifecycle to LiveStreamRecovery while retaining trust mutation, peer lifetime, logging and packet transmission; MOD-3.7 delegates announce/Kad cadence, byte-compatible announce projection and immutable numerical diagnostics to LiveStreamAnnouncer and LiveStreamSnapshot while retaining the established manager lock and external snapshot acquisition order.

MOD-3.1 replaces coordinator-owned broadcaster/viewer lifecycle scalars with explicit LiveBroadcastSession and LiveViewerSession composition; MOD-3.2 replaces the two coordinator-owned peer lists with a single portable LivePeerSet; MOD-3.3 replaces coordinator-owned viewer and broadcaster chunk containers with two bounded LiveChunkWindow instances and an explicit relay-sequence presence flag; MOD-3.4 replaces coordinator-owned pin, replay and trust stores with bounded LiveStreamSecurity composition plus a pointer-free legacy trust adapter; MOD-3.5 composes bounded LiveStreamFanout state while Packet and CUpDownClient remain behind the transport adapter; MOD-3.6 replaces coordinator-owned in-flight, replenishment and emergency fields with bounded LiveStreamRecovery composition plus a typed endpoint adapter; MOD-3.7 replaces coordinator-owned announce/Kad timers with LiveStreamAnnouncer composition and moves public pointer-free diagnostic types to LiveStreamSnapshot, reducing the header below the 700-line hard stop.
